tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. Each player plays one card, following the led suit. Trumps beat the led suit; among trumps the higher rank wins.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click a card to select it. The trump suit is decided by the deal and shown in the header.
tutorial.playButton: After selecting a card, play it with this button.
tutorial.scoreTable: Team scores. You (player 0) and player 2 are Team A; players 1 and 3 are Team B.
tutorial.pointInfo: Card points are A = 11, 3 = 10, K = 4, Q = 3, and J = 2; all other cards score 0. The last trick adds 1 point. The team with at least 61 points wins the deal; the first team to win the target number of deals (default 21) wins the game.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
